### The Burden Giveaway
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-august-28-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 140:6-7
Points:
- David's unwavering confidence in God's protection was forged through firsthand experience.
- Rather than relying on physical strength or weaponry, David consistently entrusted his battles to God.
- Remembering past instances of the Lord's faithfulness strengthens our trust in present difficulties.
- Believers are urged to actively release their anxieties and cast their burdens onto God.
- God's proven history of deliverance assures us that He will sustain us through any circumstance.
